Vibe Coding Robotics Part 7

Implemented an ornithopter mechanism with Gemini Pro, and generated a Leonardo da Vinci style UI using Nano Banana to go with it.

thread.name: Dilum Sanjaya
thread.text: The workflow isn't really that different from my other Vibe Coding Robotics posts. However, this one took even longer than it did to build Theo Jansen's Strandbeest simulator. When there are a lot of moving parts, LLMs struggle a lot.

title: Vibe Coding Robotics 第 7 篇：扑翼机构 + 达芬奇风格 UI
summary: 作者系列作品第 7 篇：用 Gemini Pro 实现扑翼机（ornithopter）机构模拟，用 Nano Banana 生成达芬奇手稿风格的 UI。thread 里说明工作流和之前的系列类似，但比 Strandbeest 模拟器耗时更久。是用 AI 做机械仿真可视化的案例。
